purpose: Audit the public Zenodo 1984-2024 Astrid/Mertz/SANAE emperor-penguin dataset as an independent machine-readable route for Paper 3 while the UK Polar Data Centre tracking archive is unavailable.

source.publication: Macdonald et al. 2026, Antarctic Science, doi:10.1017/S0954102025100515

download_strategy.route_zip: HTTP Range / remote ZIP access; do not download the 2.4 GB archive wholesale
download_strategy.allowed_members: Only .shp, .dbf, .shx, .prj, .cpg and small text metadata needed for schema inspection.

interpretation_boundary: Distance-to-fast-ice route shapefiles are not automatically equivalent to colony-location tracks.
Using route start coordinates as colony positions requires a separate frozen semantic validation against the publication/method definition.
The Zenodo route is an independent data lane, not a post-outcome rescue of the unavailable PDC server.
next_gate_if_passed: Freeze a semantic test of whether each route geometry start point corresponds to the mapped colony position on that observation date; only then may route-derived colony coordinates enter the aliasing metric.
